state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-01-15? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: relocation lump sum a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children
state.step_intent: Find the relocation lump sum that applies to: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today?

passages.source: HB-13 §3 | HR policy: relocation support — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-01-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-37
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 750 EUR was added to the standard relocation lump sum. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location.

passages.source: HB-37 §3 | HR policy: relocation support — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-13
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 750 EUR is added to the standard relocation lump sum. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.

passages.source: HB-13 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-01-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-37
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 4000 EUR. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim.

passages.source: HB-37 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-13
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 3500 EUR. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.

passages.source: HB-06 §3 | Policy FAQ — Current relocation lump sum | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard relocation lump sum? A: 3500 EUR, as set in HB-37 §2 (effective 2026-04-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-12.
